study_type: targeted evidence audit, descriptive reanalysis, conditional scenarios and proposed protocol

claims.claim: A supplied-oil batch was reported at 8.1 ug/kg; cited limit 2.0 ug/kg.
claims.limits: Company self-test relayed by regulator; not random market sampling or every downstream bottle.

claims.claim: Selected finished-product tests reported 4.3, 3.8 and 2.6 ug/kg.
claims.limits: See per-row original URLs. Different notices may share samples or upstream batches.

claims.claim: Sparse 2021-2026 tests do not establish historical sustained supra-limit finished oil exposure.
claims.limits: Report p.27. 14.8 ug/kg intermediate oil must not be treated as a household finished-oil measurement.

claims.claim: Taiwan 2013-2023 crude breast rate +53.0%; WHO2000 ASR +30.1%.
claims.limits: Female population denominator. WHO2000 names weights, not a world rate.

claims.claim: Korea crude increase +69.6%; Taiwan is not uniquely highest or fastest among these comparators.
claims.limits: Different Korean report vintages and Japan 2016 transition retained. Singapore annual history unverified.

claims.claim: Oiltrace exported session-estimate sums were10828 on16-22July2026 and100 on13-19October2026, a99.1% decline.
claims.limits: Retrospective equal-window comparison of one self-selected advocacy site. Session estimates are not people, exposure or disease. Daily/channel estimates are not exactly additive to the report total. No government/media diversion causal effect identified.

claims.claim: Recorded daily traffic first fell after its16July peak on17July; by19July it was76.4% below peak, before the20July notice; by28July it was97.9% below peak, before the29July announcement.
claims.limits: Selected source-linked communication dates, not a complete media census. Peak may reflect early collection/launch publicity. No pre-collection baseline, within-day ordering, formal break-point estimate or identified causal media/government effect.

claims.claim: Labeled PAH4 migrated from oil to fumes with a temperature-related pattern.
claims.limits: Abstract/partial preview; PAH4 is not a validated incident BaP coefficient or human absorption rate.

claims.claim: Taiwan cumulative cooking exposure was associated with lung cancer; OR3.17, CI1.34-7.68.
claims.limits: Cases2002-2010; no incident-oil/BaP measurement. Not evidence of a recent exposure onset.

claims.claim: High associations also occur outside Taiwan; other cooking studies are null.
claims.limits: OR/HR, exposure definitions, occupations and populations differ. No valid country effect ranking.

claims.claim: Orally administered tracer reached breast tissue and formed adducts.
claims.limits: Participants already awaiting cancer surgery. Not new incidence, inhaled route or a fixed mutation.

claims.claim: Breast-cancer studies of dietary and ambient PAH/BaP have positive and null results.
claims.limits: Source types and measures differ; E3N analyses overlap; no event-specific association observed.

claims.claim: High PAH/high BOADICEA joint group OR4.09, CI1.38-12.13.
claims.limits: 80 cases156 controls; interaction p0.09; not pure BRCA or oil exposure effect; not probability.

claims.claim: 2024 survey-based summary: partnered women domestic work2.00h/day, partners0.73.
claims.limits: Official statistical summary p20; broad domestic work, not cooking exposure; no universal cultural inference.

claims.claim: Four household scenarios account for cooking for4/8 diners and near-source exposure.
claims.limits: Assumed parameters, not mean/P95/worst-case. Oil handling is not personal intake. No measured kitchen doses.

claims.claim: Hypothetical20-year adult route-specific model outputs1.528-4.746 per million.
claims.limits: Not breast-specific, observed burden or event duration. Relative zeroBaP; omits full fumes and thermal generation.

claims.claim: Reporting-system delay documented; current2024/2025 cohort completeness not obtained.
claims.limits: Does not establish deliberate suppression or that agency holds only2023 records.

claims.claim: Transparency, historical reconstruction, independent sampling/follow-up and administrative review are warranted.
claims.limits: Author policy judgment; lower action threshold than disease attribution; independent oversight and public correction proposed.

claims.claim: Evaluate targeted preventive support and any extra imaging through benefit-harm assessment.
claims.limits: Not a recommendation for all oil buyers to undergo extra MRI/mammography; screening and diagnosis differ.

claims.claim: No estimate of event-specific BaP exposure causing breast-cancer rise is identified.
claims.limits: Requires historical dose, appropriate time windows, linked outcomes, person-time and confounder/screening control.
